articles.title: Google DeepMind Launches Powerful AI Tool to Help Fight Cyber Attacks
articles.summary: Google DeepMind has released a new artificial intelligence model specially designed to help protect computer systems from hackers and cyber threats. The AI can read and understand up to one million pieces of information at once, making it far more powerful than earlier tools. Instead of being made available to everyone straight away, it is first being shared only with trusted cybersecurity experts through a special programme called Fairwind. Scientists say this is an important step toward building AI systems that can handle long, complicated tasks on their own — not just answer simple questions. This development is part of a global race to use AI for important professional work.

lv1: What is the name of the programme through which Google DeepMind is sharing its new AI tool? (谷歌DeepMind透過哪個計劃分享其新的人工智能工具？)
Who is the new AI tool designed to help? (這個新的人工智能工具是專門為幫助哪些人而設計的？)
lv2: Why do you think Google DeepMind decided to share the AI tool with trusted experts first, rather than releasing it to everyone at the same time? (你認為谷歌DeepMind為什麼決定先與受信任的專家分享這個工具，而不是同時向所有人開放？)
How might an AI tool that can process one million pieces of information at once be more useful in fighting cybercrime than older tools? (一個能同時處理一百萬條信息的人工智能工具，在打擊網絡犯罪方面比舊工具有何優勝之處？)
lv3: Should powerful AI tools like this be kept only for government or trusted experts, or should they be open to the public? What are the risks and benefits of each approach? (像這樣強大的人工智能工具，應只限政府或受信任的專家使用，還是應向公眾開放？兩種做法各有什麼風險和好處？)

As AI becomes more capable of handling complex professional tasks, do you think it could eventually replace human cybersecurity experts? What skills might humans always need to bring that AI cannot? (隨著人工智能愈來愈能處理複雜的專業工作，你認為它最終能否取代人類網絡安全專家？有哪些技能是人類始終擁有而人工智能無法替代的？)

articles.title: China and the US Agree to Lower Trade Taxes and Talk About AI Together
articles.summary: China and the United States have reached a new agreement to reduce special taxes — called tariffs — on thirty billion dollars' worth of goods traded between the two countries. The two nations have also agreed to start formal talks about artificial intelligence for the first time. This is seen as an important step in calming a long-running trade dispute between the world's two largest economies. Experts say the deal could lead to more cooperation worth up to fifty billion dollars in the future. The agreement came during a period of renewed diplomatic contact between the two countries, raising hopes for a more stable relationship.

lv1: How much money worth of goods will have lower tariffs under the new China-US agreement? (根據中美新協議，價值多少金額的商品將獲減低關稅？)
Apart from trade taxes, what other important topic did China and the US agree to discuss? (除了貿易稅外，中美還同意就哪個重要議題展開對話？)
lv2: Why might lower tariffs between China and the US be good news for ordinary people in both countries? (中美之間降低關稅，為何對兩國的普通市民來說可能是好消息？)
Why do you think it is significant that the two countries agreed to talk about artificial intelligence together for the first time? (你認為兩國首次同意就人工智能展開對話，為何是一件重要的事？)
lv3: Trade disputes between powerful countries can affect people all over the world. Do you think organisations like the United Nations should have more power to resolve such disputes? Why or why not? (大國之間的貿易爭端可影響全球各地的人。你認為聯合國等機構是否應擁有更大權力來解決此類爭端？為什麼？)

Some people worry that if the US and China cooperate on AI, it could allow one country to gain advantages over the other in technology. How can countries cooperate on technology while also protecting their own national interests? (有人擔心若中美在人工智能方面合作，可能令一方在科技上佔優。各國在合作發展科技的同時，應如何保護本國的利益？)

articles.title: 國慶煙花璀璨維港　約38萬市民共慶77周年
articles.summary: 香港昨晚在維多利亞港上空舉行國慶煙花匯演，警方估計約有38萬人到場觀賞。煙花造型多姿多彩，包括太陽花及宇宙圖案，在夜空中閃耀綻放。與此同時，香港同胞亦於10月2日舉辦國慶文藝晚會，並設有無人機表演助興，氣氛熱烈。今年是中華人民共和國成立77周年，各項慶祝活動吸引大批市民及旅客參與，共同感受節日氣氛。

lv1: 今年是中華人民共和國成立第幾周年？
警方估計有多少人觀看了維港煙花匯演？
lv2: 你認為香港為什麼每年都會在維多利亞港舉辦煙花匯演來慶祝國慶節？
除了煙花表演，主辦單位還安排了什麼節目來慶祝國慶？這些活動有什麼特別之處？
lv3: 有人認為舉辦大型煙花表演費用高昂，且對環境造成污染；也有人認為這類活動能凝聚社區。你認為城市應繼續舉辦傳統煙花表演，還是改用更環保的方式慶祝節日？請說明理由。
國慶節是讓市民認識國家歷史和文化的重要時機。你認為學校和社會應如何幫助年輕一代更深入了解國家的發展歷程？

articles.title: 台灣首批F-16V戰機今日抵台　軍購計劃歷經多年終落實
articles.summary: 台灣向美國訂購的66架全新F-16V Block70戰機中，首批兩架於今日（10月2日）飛抵台東志航空軍基地。這批戰機的採購協議早於2019年達成，原定2023年開始交付，但因生產線安排等問題而一再推遲。兩架戰機於8月中旬從美國本土起飛，途經夏威夷後行程一度暫停，直至台灣空軍正式確認抵台日期。F-16V是目前台灣空軍將裝備的最先進戰鬥機型號之一。

lv1: 台灣今日接收的F-16V戰機是從哪個國家購買的？
首批抵台的F-16V戰機共有多少架？
lv2: 台灣採購F-16V戰機的計劃為何一再延誤？這對台灣的國防有什麼影響？
一個地區購買先進戰鬥機，可能對該地區的局勢產生什麼影響？請從不同角度分析。
lv3: 有人認為購買先進武器能保障國家安全，也有人認為這會加劇地區緊張局勢。你認為增強軍事力量與維持地區和平之間應如何取得平衡？
台灣海峽的局勢對香港及亞洲其他地方的經濟和社會有何潛在影響？作為香港學生，你認為我們應如何關注和理解這類地緣政治議題？
